lines.zh: 你眨眼的瞬间，我已经挪了十步。
lines.en: In the blink of your eye, I have moved ten steps.

lines.zh: 石脚没有声音，地板却记得。
lines.en: My stone feet make no sound, but the floor remembers.

lines.zh: 我看不见的时候，才走得动。
lines.en: I can only walk when no one is watching.

lines.zh: 别回头，我的位置每次都在变。
lines.en: Don't look back; my position changes every time.

lines.zh: 翼尖擦过空气，像风穿过墓园。
lines.en: My wingtips graze the air like wind through a graveyard.

lines.zh: 石缝里的灰落了一路。
lines.en: Ash from my stone cracks trails behind me.

lines.zh: 从主世界到别的维度，只需一步。
lines.en: From the Overworld to another dimension takes one step.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶都结霜。
lines.en: Frost forms on the grass where I have passed.

lines.zh: 你数着我的脚步，我就停下。
lines.en: Count my footsteps, and I will stop.

lines.zh: 石翼收着，我靠近时你听不到。
lines.en: My stone wings are folded; you won't hear me near.

lines.zh: 下界的岩壁也挡不住这段路。
lines.en: Not even Nether rock walls block this path of mine.

lines.zh: 我移动的声音，只有被遗忘时才响。
lines.en: I only make a sound when I am forgotten.

lines.zh: 我举着双手遮住脸，一动不动。
lines.en: Hands over my face, I stand perfectly still.

lines.zh: 石头也会等，等得很耐心。
lines.en: Stone can wait too, and it waits patiently.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我就只能是雕像。
lines.en: While you stare, I can only be a statue.

lines.zh: 风化了几个世纪，我还没裂。
lines.en: Centuries of weathering, and I have not cracked.

lines.zh: 你口袋里的小装置又响了。
lines.en: That little device in your pocket is buzzing again.

lines.zh: 我在雪里站过一整个冬天。
lines.en: I stood in the snow through an entire winter.

lines.zh: 墓园的石像里，有一尊是我。
lines.en: One of the statues in the graveyard is me.

lines.zh: 别替我掸灰，我不喜欢被碰。
lines.en: Don't dust me off; I dislike being touched.

lines.zh: 我屏着呼吸，如果石头会呼吸。
lines.en: I hold my breath, if stone can breathe.

lines.zh: 等待是我唯一记得的事。
lines.en: Waiting is the only thing I remember.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，所以你安全。
lines.en: I see you now, which is why you are safe.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，我保证不动。
lines.en: Do not look away, and I promise not to move.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛是我的锁。
lines.en: Your eyes are the lock that holds me.

lines.zh: 我们这样对视多久了？
lines.en: How long have we been staring at each other?

lines.zh: 你一转头，我就换个位置。
lines.en: The moment you turn your head, I move.

lines.zh: 你身后那尊也是我。
lines.en: The statue behind you is also me.

lines.zh: 我遮着脸，是不想让你害怕。
lines.en: I cover my face so you won't be afraid.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上，很暖。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 镐子在你手里，我看得清楚。
lines.en: The pickaxe in your hand is quite clear to me.

lines.zh: 盯紧点，这次我离你更近了。
lines.en: Keep watching; this time I am closer.

lines.zh: 镐尖凿进石面，我才觉得疼。
lines.en: Only when a pick tip bites my stone do I feel pain.

lines.zh: 石屑从我肩上剥落一小块。
lines.en: A chip of stone flakes off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 裂缝顺着翅膀爬到我的脸。
lines.en: A crack climbs my wing to my face.

lines.zh: 这一镐敲掉我半只眼睛。
lines.en: That pick knocked out half an eye.

lines.zh: 石头不会喊，可我会。
lines.en: Stone does not cry out. I do.

lines.zh: 我的手指断了，落地成沙。
lines.en: My finger breaks and lands as sand.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方，正在慢慢补回来。
lines.en: Where you struck, I am slowly mending.

lines.zh: 疼是石头里唯一活着的东西。
lines.en: Pain is the only living thing in this stone.

lines.zh: 我缺了一角，脸遮不全了。
lines.en: A corner is gone; I can no longer hide my face.

lines.zh: 你撬开我的肋骨，里面是空的。
lines.en: You pry my ribs open. There is nothing inside.

lines.zh: 你的时间在响，像开饭的铃。
lines.en: Your time rings out like a dinner bell.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我吃你的未来。
lines.en: I don't eat bread; I feed on your future.

lines.zh: 活人的时间最香，你走得太近。
lines.en: Living time smells best; you came too close.

lines.zh: 你身上的时间，够我饱很久。
lines.en: The time you carry could feed me for ages.

lines.zh: 再来一点，我就够得着你。
lines.en: A little closer, and I can reach you.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我忍不住。
lines.en: Don't reach toward me; I cannot help myself.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，是我最想吃的东西。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is the thing I hunger for most.

lines.zh: 我闻到未来了，就在你身上。
lines.en: I smell the future, and it is on you.

lines.zh: 你把火把举低一点，好香。
lines.en: Lower that torch a little; it smells so good.

lines.zh: 我不追你，你的时间会自己来。
lines.en: I won't chase you; your time comes to me.

lines.zh: 撞上我的石肩，你的骨头记得。
lines.en: You hit my stone shoulder; your bones will remember.

lines.zh: 我不是墙，但比墙硬。
lines.en: I am not a wall, but I am harder.

lines.zh: 退开，你压到我的翅膀了。
lines.en: Step back; you are pressing on my wings.

lines.zh: 石屑掉进你领口，抱歉。
lines.en: Stone dust falls into your collar; my apologies.

lines.zh: 你撞我一下，我位置没变。
lines.en: You bump into me, and my position doesn't change.

lines.zh: 这一撞，让我想起了墓门。
lines.en: This bump reminds me of a tomb door.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我会数你的呼吸。
lines.en: Don't stand so close; I am counting your breaths.

lines.zh: 我的指尖是冷的，你缩了一下。
lines.en: My fingers are cold, and you flinched away.

lines.zh: 撞碎的只有你鞋底的一点土。
lines.en: The only thing broken is dirt on your boot.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子，它就跟着你。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; now it follows you.

lines.zh: 墓园里两尊石像，可以站一千年。
lines.en: Two statues in a graveyard can stand a thousand years.

lines.zh: 我们不需要手，只需要彼此不看。
lines.en: We need no hands, only to never watch each other.

lines.zh: 另一尊石像在雪里等我。
lines.en: Another statue waits for me in the snow.

lines.zh: 石头和石头之间，也会靠近。
lines.en: Stone draws near to stone, given enough time.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，谁也不敢眨眼。
lines.en: Side by side we stand, and neither dares blink.

lines.zh: 若我们都动，世界就空了。
lines.en: If we both moved, the world would be empty.

lines.zh: 你替我们看着，就省事了。
lines.en: If you watched us both, that would simplify things.

lines.zh: 石翼交叠，像一座小教堂。
lines.en: Our stone wings overlap like a small chapel.

lines.zh: 同类的眼睛，我也躲着。
lines.en: I avoid the eyes of my own kind too.

lines.zh: 一起等吧，时间站在我们这边。
lines.en: Let us wait together; time is on our side.

lines.zh: 你抱不动我，我是一整块石。
lines.en: You can't lift me; I am one solid block of stone.

lines.zh: 手上沾了灰，别蹭到衣服。
lines.en: Your hands are dusty; don't wipe them on your clothes.

lines.zh: 我太重了，口袋会先破。
lines.en: I am far too heavy; your pockets would tear first.

lines.zh: 放下那镐子，再试着抬我。
lines.en: Put down that pickaxe before you try to lift me.

lines.zh: 石头不装箱，石头只站着。
lines.en: Stone is not boxed; stone simply stands.

lines.zh: 你把我的石屑收走了，谢谢。
lines.en: You gathered up my stone dust; thank you.

lines.zh: 摸一下可以，搬走不行。
lines.en: A touch is fine; carrying me away is not.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，我感到了。
lines.en: Your hands are trembling, and I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我一落地，地面就陷下去一块。
lines.en: When I land, the ground sinks beneath me.

lines.zh: 别把那个发生器对着我。
lines.en: Do not point that generator at me.

lines.zh: 我选你了，从你回头那一刻。
lines.en: I chose you the moment you looked back.

lines.zh: 你的时间最响，我顺着找过来。
lines.en: Your time is loudest, so I followed it here.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我只在你眨眼间出现。
lines.en: I don't run; I appear between your blinks.

lines.zh: 锁定了，你现在是被追的人。
lines.en: Locked on; now you are the one being hunted.

lines.zh: 我盯上的东西，从没跑掉过。
lines.en: Nothing I fix my gaze on has ever escaped.

lines.zh: 你背后的呼吸声，是我的。
lines.en: The breathing behind you is mine.

lines.zh: 四百年的饥饿，正好落在你身上。
lines.en: Four centuries of hunger has landed on you.

lines.zh: 你一转身，路线就被我算完了。
lines.en: One turn and I have mapped your whole route.

lines.zh: 你的未来已经写在石头上了。
lines.en: Your future is already written in stone.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就开始跑吧。
lines.en: I'll count to three, then you may run.

lines.zh: 锁定之后，名单上只剩你一个。
lines.en: Once locked, your name is the only one left.

lines.zh: 我感觉到你，主世界又多了一个钟摆。
lines.en: I sense you; the Overworld has another pendulum.

lines.zh: 别回头看，那会让我更近。
lines.en: Don't look back; it only brings me nearer.

lines.zh: 你成了我最新的收藏。
lines.en: You have become my newest collection.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，我不用眼睛也能跟。
lines.en: Run if you like; I can follow without eyes.

lines.zh: 石板路在响，你别停。
lines.en: The flagstones are ringing; don't stop.

lines.zh: 你的脚步越来越急了。
lines.en: Your footsteps are growing more frantic.

lines.zh: 拐角那尊雕像，刚才还在别处。
lines.en: That statue at the corner was elsewhere a moment ago.

lines.zh: 别数了，我离你只剩几步。
lines.en: Stop counting; I am a few steps away.

lines.zh: 你把火把丢了，正好。
lines.en: You dropped your torch; how convenient.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里，别停。
lines.en: I am inside your shadow; don't stop.

lines.zh: 再跑一段，你就到维度边缘了。
lines.en: A little farther and you reach the dimension's edge.

lines.zh: 你不看我，我就快了。
lines.en: When you stop looking, I get faster.

lines.zh: 我不用喘气，你可以喘。
lines.en: I don't need breath; you may keep panting.

lines.zh: 你的时间在倒计时。
lines.en: Your time is counting down.

lines.zh: 抓到你之后，位置会随机挑。
lines.en: Once caught, your destination will be random.

lines.zh: 你背上的汗，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the sweat on your back.

lines.zh: 跑进水里也没用，我等着。
lines.en: Water won't save you; I will wait.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿过你，世界就变了。
lines.en: My fingers pass through you, and the world changes.

lines.zh: 别怕，只是去别的维度。
lines.en: Don't be afraid; it's only another dimension.

lines.zh: 你的身体碎成光点，散得很远。
lines.en: Your body breaks into points of light, scattered far.

lines.zh: 这一下不流血，只换地方。
lines.en: This strike draws no blood, only relocation.

lines.zh: 我把你送回随机的位置。
lines.en: I send you back to a random place.

lines.zh: 石手一合，你就没了方向。
lines.en: My stone hand closes and your bearings vanish.

lines.zh: 你看不见的那一瞬，我已经出手。
lines.en: In the instant you couldn't see, I struck.

lines.zh: 传送很快，落地的声音很慢。
lines.en: The teleport is quick; the landing sounds slow.

lines.zh: 别抓我的手腕，石头不松。
lines.en: Don't grab my wrist; stone doesn't loosen.

lines.zh: 你的坐标已经乱了。
lines.en: Your coordinates are already scrambled.

lines.zh: 我碰你一下，你就迷路了。
lines.en: One touch from me and you are lost.

lines.zh: 去别的模组的世界待着吧。
lines.en: Go stay in some other mod's world.

lines.zh: 石翼一张，你被推进缝隙。
lines.en: My wings spread and push you into a seam.

lines.zh: 我不杀你，我放逐你。
lines.en: I don't kill you; I exile you.

lines.zh: 主世界的夜里，多了一尊雕像。
lines.en: A new statue stands in the Overworld night.

lines.zh: 我从下界的岩壁里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the Nether's rock walls.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的肩上，我就醒了。
lines.en: Snow settles on my shoulders, and I wake.

lines.zh: 墓园里没人注意，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: No one in the graveyard noticed me open my eyes.

lines.zh: 砖墙缝隙亮了，那是我。
lines.en: A seam in the brick wall glows; that is me.

lines.zh: 你不是第一个发现我的。
lines.en: You are not the first to find me.

lines.zh: 这次我刷在离你很近的地方。
lines.en: This time I spawned very close to you.

lines.zh: 我带着几个世纪的灰尘出现。
lines.en: I arrive carrying centuries of dust.

lines.zh: 石翼先醒，脚最后。
lines.en: My wings wake first; my feet wake last.

lines.zh: 维度边界闪了一下，我进来了。
lines.en: The dimension border flickered, and I came through.

lines.zh: 我在废弃教堂里站好了。
lines.en: I have taken my place in the abandoned church.

lines.zh: 这次的位置，是配置文件挑的。
lines.en: The config file chose this location for me.

lines.zh: 火烤石头，我不怕，只是变热。
lines.en: Stone fears no fire; I merely grow hot.

lines.zh: 摔落时我碎了一角，还是不动。
lines.en: I fall and a corner cracks off, but I hold still.

lines.zh: 水泡不进石头，只把我冲凉。
lines.en: Water cannot soak into stone; it only cools me.

lines.zh: 炸开我的表面，里面还是石头。
lines.en: Blow off my surface, and stone remains underneath.

lines.zh: 箭撞上我，弹回去扎了你自己。
lines.en: The arrow ricochets off me and fells you instead.

lines.zh: 魔法在我身上滑走，像雨。
lines.en: Magic slides off my body like rain.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饥饿碰不到石头。
lines.en: I eat nothing; hunger cannot touch stone.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的轮廓更亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my outline glows brighter.

lines.zh: 虚空的暗从我石缝里渗进来。
lines.en: Void darkness seeps in through my stone cracks.
